I need to identify the concrete markdown processing implementations, their constructors, and the components that hold the interface.

Searching the codebase now.

Reading v1.go to find construction details. Checking for other markdown.Service implementations beyond the unexported service struct.

Checking whether markdown_renderer.go is a standalone implementation or internal to the service.

Checking whether the memopayload runner starts at runtime and locating other NewService call sites.

The concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. Production construction happens in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `APIV1Service` using `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())`. Tests construct it in `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go`. The `markdown.Service` interface is held by `APIV1Service` in `v1.go` and by `RSSService` in `server.go`.

The memopayload runner holds the interface as a struct field, yet it does not appear to be constructed in production. RebuildMemoPayload consumes the interface as a parameter. I am checking whether RSSService receives the same concrete instance.

message.text:
Only one concrete implementation executes at runtime: an unexported `service` returned by `markdown.NewService`.

`NewAPIV1Service` in `v1.go` constructs the service via `markdown.NewService` with tag and mention extensions. The same instance is passed to `RSSService`. `APIV1Service` and `RSSService` both hold the interface in their `MarkdownService` fields. `memopayload.Runner` also carries the interface type, though it is never instantiated in production.

`RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the interface as a parameter rather than holding it. `MarkdownRenderer` is merely an internal helper and does not implement `markdown.Service`. Only one configuration of `NewService` runs in production.
